versions.changelog: Added frontmatter permissions (bash, curl). Fixed description to disclose write operations (swap/execute, contract/write). Added wallet privacy and irreversible transaction warnings. Removed off-scope research endpoints. Human approval required for all write operations. Updated description for accuracy.

Initial release of defi-intelligence-x402 — a comprehensive DeFi analytics and execution toolkit.

- Offers 16 endpoints including token prices, swap quotes, wallet analytics, portfolio tracking, DeFi positions, gas oracle, ENS resolution, and smart contract reads.
- Supports both read and write operations—portfolio analysis, yield tracking, token swaps, and contract execution.
- Each data call is powered by real x402 micropayments ($0.001–$0.015 USDC).
- Includes cost breakdown per endpoint and clear workflow strategies for research, profiling, and monitoring.
- Outlines example bash usage for each endpoint.
